details: The cryptocurrency market experienced a significant downturn, with Bitcoin dropping below $60,000 to multi-year lows and Ethereum falling below $1,600. This broad sell-off was primarily driven by higher-than-expected US inflation data, with the Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) index rising to 4.1%, dimming hopes for imminent Federal Reserve rate cuts. Simultaneously, spot Bitcoin ETFs saw substantial net outflows, exceeding $1 billion over two days. The market witnessed nearly $1 billion in leveraged long position liquidations, pushing the Crypto Fear and Greed Index into "extreme fear" territory.
title: Bitcoin Plunges Below $60K Amid US Inflation Fears and ETF Outflows, $1 Billion Liquidated

details: Tether's stablecoin, USDT, reached a market capitalization of $186 billion, temporarily surpassing Ethereum, whose market cap fell below $185 billion after a 5.2% price drop in the last 24 hours. This shift highlights the growing dominance of stablecoins within the crypto ecosystem, particularly during periods of market volatility and altcoin weakness.
title: Tether's USDT Briefly Surpasses Ethereum in Market Cap Amid Altcoin Weakness

details: Uniswap and Spark have introduced the FX Layer, a new unified liquidity network specifically designed to streamline the stablecoin market. This initiative aims to simplify the swapping of stablecoins issued by different providers and build infrastructure for anticipated hundreds of new issuers. As part of the launch, Spark plans to migrate approximately $150 million in liquidity to Uniswap v4, initially supporting USDS, USDT, and PYUSD.
title: Uniswap and Spark Launch FX Layer to Unify Stablecoin Liquidity

details: The Atlas Capital Team, through its Dubai subsidiary Atlas AI Labs, is planning to launch USAFi in Q3 2026. USAFi will be a regulated digital security backed by a Nasdaq-listed ETF, operating under Dubai's Virtual Asset Regulatory Authority (VARA) framework. Notably, economist Nouriel Roubini, a long-time critic of cryptocurrencies, is backing this project, with Securitize providing the tokenization infrastructure.
title: Dubai to Launch Regulated Nasdaq ETF-Backed Token with Nouriel Roubini's Backing

details: Approximately $10 billion in notional value of Bitcoin options are set to expire on Deribit on June 26, 2026. The vast majority of these contracts are bullish call options that have fallen out-of-the-money due to recent spot price declines. Market participants are anticipating intense volatility as dealers unwind their hedges and traders adjust their positions in response to the expiry.
title: Massive $10 Billion Bitcoin Options Expiry on Deribit Expected to Fuel Volatility

details: Amidst a widespread cryptocurrency market sell-off, Aave (AAVE) stood out by posting a significant 13.27% gain in the past 24 hours. This notable performance highlights strong demand and positive investor sentiment specifically for Aave, demonstrating resilience in certain decentralized finance (DeFi) assets despite the broader bearish market conditions affecting Bitcoin and Ethereum.
title: Aave Defies Market Downturn with Over 13% Gains
